results.title: Updates to the Roblox Terms of Use [November 2024] - News & Alerts - Developer Forum | Roblox
results.content:
User Terms

Added Roblox commerce terms to enable eligible creators to sell physical merchandise within their experiences and as we integrate with various e-commerce platforms such as Shopify. These terms will give users the ability to purchase goods and services to be used outside of Roblox (e.g., clothing, movie tickets) and transact in real currency and processed through third party retailer websites and e-commerce platforms on the Roblox platform. [...] Appendix C

Added a clarification regarding EU Users’ ability to engage certified out-of-court dispute settlement bodies in accordance with Article 21 of the Digital Services Act.

Changed other portions of the Roblox Terms to align with these changes.

## Privacy Policy

Added information about how we will enable account recovery when the age on the account is adjusted to 12 or younger.

Updated language pertaining to the information we collect and share for safety and security purposes. [...] # [Updates to the Roblox Terms of Use [November 2024]](/t/updates-to-the-roblox-terms-of-use-november-2024/3180048)

Hi everyone,

On October 2, we will update our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

The changes are to support new products that foster safety, engagement, and growth on the platform. Similar to our recent Terms of Use announcement, our goal is to provide transparency about the updates we’ve made and what it means for you.
